note: Independent expectation for the G1.6b httpx lab run: one application per HTTP(S) endpoint the inventory declares, on the service that answers it, with the status its own image returns on `/` (Tomcat 9.0.30 has no ROOT context, so 404 is the expected page, not a failure). Derived from deploy/lab/inventory.json, never from parser output; technology is not pinned here (it comes from the recorded run). For Tomcat the expectation names the product, version and CPE the origin prints in its 404 page body (`Apache Tomcat/9.0.30`), which the parser fills into the tool's own CPE (`apache:tomcat:*`); the AJP port has no HTTP answer and no product.
